notes: Flanders Marine Institute (2023). Maritime Boundaries Geodatabase: Maritime Boundaries and Exclusive Economic Zones (200NM), version 12. https://doi.org/10.14284/632. WFS layer title 'Exclusive Economic Zones (200 NM) (v12, world, 2023)'; 285 features (all polygons worldwide, no filter). Retrieved via VLIZ GeoServer WFS 1.0.0 (lon/lat axis order) because the marineregions.org download_file.php?name=World_EEZ_v12_20231025.zip route requires a form with personal data (name, organisation, e-mail, country, user category, purpose) and has no stable URL. Equivalent manual route: marineregions.org/downloads.php > Maritime Boundaries (latest version) > World EEZ v12 (2023-10-25) > Shapefile/GeoPackage > fill form > Download. WFS shapefile field names are lowercase; DBF encoding ISO-8859-1 (eez.cst). Marine Regions asks users not to make products available for download elsewhere (request, not a licence term).
